label: lnW
label_semantics: Historical IgG-Fc binding-enrichment-derived lnW; not Kd and not a prospective blinded experiment.
selection_rule: Minimize mean dev cap16 BoN-minus-exact-RandomN regret across five seeds and ten position-pair pools; ties within 1e-12 resolved by higher mean dev Spearman, then smaller lambda.
test_policy: One evaluator opening after frozen five-seed predictions; all budgets and endpoints computed in that opening; no test-based refitting or selection.
